findings: Callback receives source/ability/eligible-material IDs only. It cannot select the reserved final sacrifice, excluded source, or an ID outside the current legal list.
Decline/invalid selection constrains search only; a failed constrained search or missing final material is Unsupported, never a complete negative.
Policy witness tests execute selected funding through real actions and preserve final reserved object; no tactical ranking is supplied by the generic API.
